subject: FirstNaz Weekly Guide
intro: What you do helps to move our church forward, and we don't take that for granted. You are prayed for each week and what you give each Sunday is not just volunteer hours but real ministry.
This weekly guide is here to keep you in the loop on what's coming up, what's happening across our church, and what you need to know to serve well. Thank you for being the hands and feet of FirstNaz.
